objective: Show conditional possibility, reversal and indifference. No causal or psychological identification.

metrics.gross: Assumed nominal benefit evaluated in owner's own utility units
metrics.cost: Assumed disjoint and nonduplicated owner-borne expenses and lost opportunities at same horizon

Owner's net utility favors domination on stated numbers; cannot infer endogenous coexistence from owner self-interest

cases.notes: No prediction of conscience or intrinsic motivation.

rights_noncompensation_rule: A positive owner payoff cannot justify violation of B's independently valid rights; B's utility and standing are unmeasured in these cases.
